Repro steps:
1) POST /v1/billing/apply_promo {"account_id":"acct_0a12b3c", "code":"NEWYEAR26"}

```
{"error":"promo_code_invalid","message":"Invalid or expired promo code","code":"PROMO_INVALID"}
```
